mainEntity.name: What should I do if I suspect a foundation issue affecting my home's safety?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you notice cracks in your foundation, uneven floors, doors or windows that stick, or gaps around window frames, it's crucial to have a professional foundation inspection. These can be indicators of structural instability, which compromises your home's safety and value. Hometelligent Inc. can assess the severity of foundation problems and recommend appropriate repair solutions. Gathering any documentation of previous repairs or property surveys can provide valuable contextual relevance for the assessment, helping to understand the history of your home's structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you suspect foundation issues, look for cracks, uneven floors, or sticking doors/windows. A professional inspection is essential to assess and address the problem.
